title: Format as a Prior: Quantifying and Analyzing Bias in LLMs for Heterogeneous Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to conflicting factual claims presented in different heterogeneous data formats (texts, tables, infoboxes, and knowledge graphs). The bias is quantified using Dual Coverage Rate (DCR) to measure the model's capacity to acknowledge both conflicting inputs, and Format Preference Ratio (FPR) to measure asymmetric preferences for specific formats. The study also manipulates data-level factors such as information richness (number of entries) and structure quality (controlled syntax corruption) to observe their impact on format preferences.
